title: Missing translations for sulfur items
description: The new sulfur items (sulfur, potent_sulfur, sulfur_powder) are registered in ModItems.java but lack translation entries in src/main/resources/assets/dagmod/lang/en_us.json. This will result in untranslated names appearing in-game.

title: Redundant asset file for sulfur_powder
description: sulfur_powder.png is a byte-for-byte duplicate of sulfur.png. Instead of maintaining a redundant texture file, the model file sulfur_powder.json should be updated to point to dagmod:item/sulfur.

title: Inefficient Creative Tab registration in ModItems
description: ModItems.java registers a separate callback for almost every single item added to the creative tabs. This results in dozens of redundant event registrations. These should be consolidated into a single lambda per tab for better performance and code cleanliness.
